akihiron.name: Akihiron
akihiron.desc: ''This strange creature hides in the deep, dark corners of the seven seas.''

ashenedtoendlessness.name: Ashened to Endlessness
ashenedtoendlessness.desc: During the Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Pyro Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using monsters from either field as material, including "Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction", and if you do, it gains 500 ATK for each material used. You can banish this card and 1 DARK Pyro monster from your GY; all monsters your opponent currently controls become Pyro until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Ashened to Endlessness" once per turn.

ashtrajasusanoo.name: Ashtraja Susanoo
ashtrajasusanoo.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can banish any number of Traps from your GY; banish that many cards on the field. During the End Phase: You can target up to 2 "Ashtra" monsters and/or "Ashtra" Traps in your GY and/or banishment; for each of them, add it to your hand or Set it, then if you targeted 2 cards, return this card to the Extra Deck. You can only use each effect of "Ashtraja Susanoo" once per turn.

atlanteanheavyinfantry.name: Atlantean Heavy Infantry
atlanteanheavyinfantry.desc: During your Main Phase, you can Normal Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent-Type monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.) When this card is sent to the Graveyard to activate a WATER monster's effect: Target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

blackwingborathespear.name: Blackwing - Bora the Spear
blackwingborathespear.desc: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Bora the Spear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

brandeddisciple.name: Branded Disciple
brandeddisciple.desc: When a monster effect activated by your opponent resolves, if that opponent's monster has 0 ATK or DEF, and you control a Level 8 or higher Fiend Fusion Monster, you can negate that activated effect. At the end of the Damage Step, if monsters with 0 ATK battled each other: You can destroy your opponent's battling monster. You can only use each effect of "Branded Disciple" once per turn.

crystalgodtistina.name: Crystal God Tistina
crystalgodtistina.desc: During your Main Phase: You can change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can send all face-up cards your opponent controls to the GY. If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can send all face-up cards your opponent controls to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Crystal God Tistina" once per turn.

daedalusmaelstrom.name: Daedalus Maelstrom
daedalusmaelstrom.desc: When your opponent would Normal or Special Summon a monster(s) while you control "Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon": Negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster(s), then if you control a WATER Link Monster, you can destroy all non-WATER monsters on the field. You can banish this card from your GY and send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use 1 "Daedalus Maelstrom" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

darksmog.name: Dark Smog
darksmog.desc: Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in your opponent's Graveyard; discard 1 Fiend-Type monster, and if you do, banish that target.

darksummoningbeast.name: Dark Summoning Beast
darksummoningbeast.desc: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions, also monsters you control cannot attack for the rest of this turn. You can only use this effect of "Dark Summoning Beast" once per turn. You can banish this card from your Graveyard; add 1 "Uria, Lord of Searing Flames", "Hamon, Lord of Striking Thunder", or "Raviel, Lord of Phantasms" from your Deck to your hand.

dododoswordsman.name: Dododo Swordsman
dododoswordsman.desc: While this Flip Summoned card is face-up on the field, it gains 3500 ATK. When this card is flipped face-up: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field; destroy them.

flametiger.name: Flame Tiger
flametiger.desc: During your Draw Phase, if this card is in your Graveyard and you control no monsters, instead of conducting your normal draw: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, banish it when it leaves the field.

grandtikielder.name: Grand Tiki Elder
grandtikielder.desc: A masked monster that wields the most deadly of curses.

gravekeeperssupernaturalist.name: Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist
gravekeeperssupernaturalist.desc:
2 "Gravekeeper's" monsters
Gains ATK/DEF equal to the combined original Levels of the materials used for its Fusion Summon x 100. While "Necrovalley" is on the field, this card, and any card in your Field Zone, cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your Main Phase: You can activate this effect; during the End Phase of this turn, add 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster or 1 "Necrovalley" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Gravekeeper's Supernaturalist" once per turn.

heromask.name: Hero Mask
heromask.desc: Target 1 face-up monster you control; send 1 "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, that target's name becomes the sent monster's name, until the End Phase.

hyena.name: Hyena
hyena.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon any number of "Hyenas" from your Deck.

infinitrackharvester.name: Infinitrack Harvester
infinitrackharvester.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Infinitrack" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Infinitrack Harvester". You can target 1 other Machine monster you control; the Levels of both that monster and this card become the combined original Levels of those 2 monsters, until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Infinitrack Harvester" once per turn.

libromancerbonded.name: Libromancer Bonded
libromancerbonded.desc: This card can be used to Ritual Summon any "Libromancer" Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from your hand or field whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the Ritual Monster you Ritual Summon. If you Ritual Summon "Libromancer Fireburst" with this effect, using "Libromancer Firestarter" on the field, it cannot be destroyed, or banished, by card effects.

neospacianmarinedolphin.name: Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin
neospacianmarinedolphin.desc: This card's name is also treated as "Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin". This card cannot be Special Summoned except with "NEX". Once per turn, you can discard 1 card to look at your opponent's hand and select 1 Monster Card in it. If you control a monster with ATK greater than or equal to the selected monster's, destroy the selected monster and inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

ninjitsuartofshadowsealing.name: Ninjitsu Art of Shadow Sealing
ninjitsuartofshadowsealing.desc: Tribute 1 "Ninja" monster to target 1 monster your opponent controls; banish that target. While that card is banished, its Monster Card Zone cannot be used. When this face-up card leaves the field: Return the card banished by this effect to the same Monster Card Zone, in the same battle position.

pendulumxyz.name: Pendulum Xyz
pendulumxyz.desc: Target 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones; Special Summon both targets, but negate their effects, then, immediately after this effect resolves, Xyz Summon 1 Xyz Monster using only those 2 monsters. When you do, you can treat the Level of 1 of the monsters the same as the other monster's. You can only activate 1 "Pendulum Xyz" per turn.

performapalinflatertapir.name: Performapal Inflater Tapir
performapalinflatertapir.desc: During damage calculation (in either player's turn), if a monster you control battles an opponent's monster: You can discard this card; neither player takes any battle damage from that battle. When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack while this card is in your Graveyard: You can discard 1 "Performapal" monster; Special Summon this card in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Performapal Inflater Tapir" once per turn.

rescueacearbitrator.name: Rescue-ACE Arbitrator
rescueacearbitrator.desc:
2+ FIRE monsters
You can only Special Summon "Rescue-ACE Arbitrator(s)" once per turn. If this card is Link Summoned: You can add 1 "Rescue-ACE Hydrant" or "Rescue-ACE HQ" from your Deck or GY to your hand. If you activate a "Rescue-ACE" Quick-Play Spell Card or a "Rescue-ACE" Normal Trap Card (except during the Damage Step): You can target 1 card your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use this effect of "Rescue-ACE Arbitrator" twice per turn.

rustinmammoth.name: Rustin Mammoth
rustinmammoth.desc: If this card is in your hand: You can banish Machine Link Monsters from your Extra Deck whose combined Link Ratings equal exactly 5; Special Summon this card. You can target 1 card you control and 1 card your opponent controls; return them to the hand. This is a Quick Effect if this card is linked to a Link-3 or higher Machine Link Monster. You can only use each effect of "Rustin Mammoth" once per turn.

senjuofthethousandhands.name: Senju of the Thousand Hands
senjuofthethousandhands.desc: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand.

sinistershadowgames.name: Sinister Shadow Games
sinistershadowgames.desc: Send 1 "Shaddoll" card from your Deck to the GY, then you can change any number of face-down Defense Position "Shaddoll" monsters you control to face-up Defense Position.

stellarknighttriverr.name: Stellarknight Triverr
stellarknighttriverr.desc:
3 Level 4 "tellarknight" monsters
During the turn you Xyz Summon this card, you cannot Special Summon monsters, except "tellarknight" monsters. If this card is Xyz Summoned: Return all other cards on the field to the hand. Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; send 1 random card from your opponent's hand to the Graveyard. If this card with Xyz Material is sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "tellarknight" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it.

summongate.name: Summon Gate
summongate.desc: Each player can Special Summon a maximum of 3 monsters from the Extra Deck each turn.

theguidingfluteofsummoningdragons.name: The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons
theguidingfluteofsummoningdragons.desc: If a Spellcaster monster is on the field: Special Summon 1 Level 5 or higher Dragon monster from your Deck, then if your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can Special Summon 1 monster from your Deck with the same name as the Summoned monster, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except Dragon or Spellcaster monsters. During your Main Phase 2, if this card is in your GY because it was sent there this turn: You can banish it; draw 1 card. You can only use each effect of "The Guiding Flute of Summoning Dragons" once per turn.

toongoblinattackforce.name: Toon Goblin Attack Force
toongoblinattackforce.desc: This card cannot attack the turn it is Summoned. If "Toon World" on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. While you control "Toon World" and your opponent controls no Toon Monsters, this card can attack your opponent directly. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase, and its battle position cannot be changed until the End Phase of your next turn.

ushioni.name: Ushi Oni
ushioni.desc: A bull fiend restored by the dark arts, this monster appears out of a jar.

xyzshift.name: Xyz Shift
xyzshift.desc: Tribute 1 Xyz Monster; Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 monster with the same Type, Attribute, and Rank as that Tributed monster had on the field, but with a different name, and if you do, attach this card to it as an Xyz Material. During the End Phase, send it to the Graveyard. You can only activate 1 "Xyz Shift" per turn.
